objectiveText: Speak with Chef Grual.
Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.
Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade. Once there, use the Shrine Bauble.
You must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.
Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.
Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub. Bring her his tusk as proof.
Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.
Verna Furlbrow wants you to deliver her recipe for Westfall Stew to Salma Saldean.
Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.
Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire. Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.
Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.
Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to talk to Wiley in Lakeshire.
Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in Stormwind.
Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.
Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
Marshal Haggard wants you to check the chest upstairs for the Faded Journal Page.
Explore the Jasperlode Mine, then report back to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
Take the Faded Journal Page to Tavernkeep Smitts.
Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.
Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.
Speak with Billy Maclure.
Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.
Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.
Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
Bring 10 Shadowhide Pendants to Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall.
Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
Gather 6 Gooey Spider Legs and bring them to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.
Go to Sven's Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.
Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.
Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.
Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.
Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.
Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of Westfall.
Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
Speak with Gramma Stonefield.
Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.
Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
Bring 3 Midnight Orbs to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
Take Verner's Note to Smith Argus in Goldshire.
Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge. Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
Go to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire and give him The Collector's Schedule.
Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.
Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.
Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.
Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker. He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.
Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.
Take Wiley's Note to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Stoutmantle.
Find and kill "the Collector" then return to Marshal Dughan with The Collector's Ring.
Speak with Madame Eva.
Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.
Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.

Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.
Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.
Deliver the supplies to Sven.
Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.
Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire wants you to bring him a bronze tube.
Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.
Retrieve Blind Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul and give it to Viktori in Darkshire.
Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire with his paw.
Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Stranglethorn Tigers.
Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.
Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Panthers.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to bring him the Fang of Bhag'thera.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Lashtail Raptors.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Jungle Stalkers.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.
Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
Find Bookie Herod's Records.
Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.
Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
Kill 12 Nightbane Dark Runner worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fang and 8 Nightbane Tainted One worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.
Speak with Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
Kill 12 Starving Dire Wolves and 8 Rabid Dire Wolves, then return to Lars at Sven's Camp on the western border of Duskwood.
Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.
Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.
Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.
Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.
Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.
Go to the Westbrook Garrison and speak with Deputy Rainer.
Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.
Report to Deputy Feldon.
Kill 15 Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, and then report back to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.
Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.
Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.
Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.
Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke
Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.
Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.
Take the book you found at Sven's farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.
Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.
See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.
Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.
Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
Return to Sven with Jitters' completed journal.
Give Jitters' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in Stormwind.
Go to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, and speak with Glorin Steelbrow.
Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Kill 12 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.
Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.
Slay Gobbler and take his head.
Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
Search for the Menethil Statuette.
Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.
Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.
Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.
Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.
Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
Find Pamela Redpath.
Find Pamela's doll.
Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.
Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.
Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.
Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.
Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.
Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Find Carlin Redpath.
Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.
Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.
Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.
Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.
Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.
Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.
Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.
Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.
Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.
Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
Find Sentinel Shaya and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar.
Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.
Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.
Speak to Maxan Anvol in Dun Morogh.
Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.
Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.
Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.
Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.
Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them. Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore where the edge of Ashenvale begins.
Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.
Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.
Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.
Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.
Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.
Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.
Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.
Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.
Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.
Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.
Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.
Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.
Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.
Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.
Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.
Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!
You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.
Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.
Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.
Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!
Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.
You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.
Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.
If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.
Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.
Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.
Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.
Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.
Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.
Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.
Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
Speak to Ogtinc in Azshara.
Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.
Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.
Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.
Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
